task:
Address the verified first-pass review findings on draft PR #585, current platform head d0b6b3bb62027b6e2e3d395e1d6ee999f11fb2f2. Work on the existing target branch only, do not open another PR, do not merge, and do not reintroduce Playwright. Read CLAUDE.md, the acceptance policy, issue #579, and PR #585 first. Before editing, merge/fetch the current integration base `migration/svelte-cypress-hard-cut` at exact head `44f005f7074b6e52ba0ddf2d471c8fb0501f4de9` into the platform branch (or otherwise produce a descendant containing both lines) and resolve conflicts by preserving the Cypress-only integration fixes plus the Svelte platform work. Use normal ancestry; no history rewrite.

Verified defects to fix:

1. Root query client ownership is wrong. `apps/web/src/lib/api/query.ts` defines the accepted singleton with staleTime 30s, gcTime 5m, retry 1, refetchOnWindowFocus false and mutation retry 0, but `src/routes/+layout.svelte` creates a second weaker QueryClient. Import and provide the one configured singleton; no other root QueryClient may be instantiated. Add a contract/component test that fails if the layout creates another client or omits the accepted defaults.

2. Persistence services are inert. `providePersistenceContext()` and `hydrateApplicationStores()` exist but are never invoked by the root application. Install the typed persistence context synchronously at the root layout/shell and hydrate every store exactly once on browser mount. SSR must remain safe. Add tests proving child consumers receive the same singleton services and legacy local/session values are hydrated during app boot, without exposing token values.

3. Separate overlay selection from durable selected-system context. `AppShell.svelte` currently derives one `selectedId` from `?system=` and uses it both for the modal and the context chip, so closing the modal erases the visible selected context instead of preserving `ed-finder:selected-system-context`. Use a distinct `overlayId` from the URL. When a valid overlay/system route establishes a selection, persist it through the selectedSystem store. Drive the selected-system context chip from the hydrated durable store; drive `SystemOverlay` only from `overlayId`. Closing the overlay removes only the URL modal parameter and restores focus/scroll while the durable selected context remains. Add unit/Cypress coverage for cold legacy hash, overlay close, context persistence, cross-tab update and uint64-max identifiers. Do not couple plannerSystemId to selected modal state.

4. Generated-call errors must honour the facade. `runGenerated()` currently immediately rethrows every `Error`, so generated health/session failures bypass structured `ApiError`. Preserve AbortError exactly, but normalise all other generated failures into `ApiError(status,path,body,message,cause)`. If a generated failure exposes a `Response`, parse it with the same lossless/empty/non-JSON response path before constructing the error; otherwise retain useful status/body/message fields. Add tests for JSON 4xx, text/empty errors, network Error, object error and AbortError. The only allowed runtime imports from generated SDK remain inside the API adapter/facade.

5. Harden persistence codecs to the actual current contracts rather than permissive casts. At minimum: validate sync keys against the existing 16–128 URL-safe contract and reject `legacy`; require pinned entries to have canonical id64, non-empty name and pinned_at string; require compare entries to have canonical id64 and non-empty name; preserve unknown valid fields; do not silently drop an entire malformed entry without a diagnostic where that would hide user data loss. Keep safe legacy numeric identifiers only when `Number.isSafeInteger`; never preserve already-rounded unsafe numbers. Wrap the existing storage read performed during `set()` so private-mode/getItem errors produce an unavailable diagnostic rather than throwing. Add exact fixtures from current React tests for each named envelope, plus corrupt/newer/invalid-entry cases. Do not invent destructive automatic rewriting of old values during hydration.

6. Harden legacy hash parsing. The project-id `decodeURIComponent` path can throw on malformed percent escapes and crash application boot. Fail closed to an honest safe destination without throwing, preserve valid encoded project IDs exactly, reject invalid/unsafe id64, and prove the shim is idempotent/no-loop. Preserve the existing React behaviour that unknown hash routes land on Finder, while unknown Svelte path routes remain honest 404s. Add tests for malformed encoding, repeated application and query/hash preservation.

7. Simplify the redundant AppShell onMount branch (`if applyLegacyHash ... else` currently bootstraps auth identically) while preserving one auth bootstrap and replace-state hash conversion. Ensure hydration occurs before UI decisions that depend on persisted state.

8. Run the exact focused platform test surface, `pnpm check`, lint, format check, unit tests, build, OpenAPI drift where feasible, and Svelte Cypress platform tests. Also run merge/conflict and repository Python contracts. Commit a coherent descendant to the existing branch through the trusted wrapper. Do not port feature UI or delete React in this remediation. No production, live DB, DNS, secret, OAuth activation, deployment, recovery or Babylon/Stage 27 runtime action.
